thread:
karen (VP Eng): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — two asks about kernel-v4 readiness and comms.

diego (Eng Runtime): short version: build is green; perf spikes seen on long-context microbatch mixes in stress tests. working on a patch for attention scheduling.

sam (SRE): can you quantify "spikes"? we need thresholds for the canary gate.
diego (Eng Runtime): p99 jumped to ~720ms on synthetic heavy-512/1024 runs at batch8 mix. p95 stayed under 300ms.

anya (Product): product wants a clear customer-facing note about transient warmup and which tiers might see blips.

jamal (EngOps): proposed gate for canary: auto-fail if p99 > 650ms or error_rate > 1.0% for 15m window. agree?

sam (SRE): agree with jamal. also add token-throughput delta within 25% of baseline.
diego (Eng Runtime): ack. I'll push a fix for scheduling this afternoon and run targeted microbenchmarks.

karen (VP Eng): owners + ETA please so I can approve canary window.
diego (Eng Runtime): patch + perf runs by 18:00 PT.

jamal (EngOps): canary tentatively tomorrow 09:00 PT if patch looks good. I'll schedule and update #eng-ops.

deploy-bot: Canary pre-check queued: id=canary-2468233333; owner=@jamal; status=pre-check

karen (VP Eng): thanks everyone — keep this thread updated with any regressions or if thresholds need tuning.
